title: VETO: Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.01785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Processing long videos with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of visual tokens, making long-form inference prohibitively expensive. While single-axis compression methods mitigate this, they hit a hard efficiency floor because they treat spatial and temporal redundancy independently. We present VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision-Language Models), a training-optional plug-in that eliminates this bottleneck through dual-axis compression: (i) an intra-frame compressor that merges semantically similar tokens within each frame via optimal-transport inspired matching, and (ii) an inter-frame compressor that identifies and merges temporally redundant frames. The key design insight is hierarchical ordering: by first compressing spatial dimensions, VETO drastically reduces the cost of subsequent global temporal matching, bypassing the efficiency wall of single-axis approaches, with an advantage

translated_title: VETO：面向视觉语言模型的视频高效令牌优化
translated_abstract: 使用视觉语言模型处理长视频受到视觉令牌二次方成本的瓶颈制约，使得长视频推理的代价极其高昂。虽然单轴压缩方法可以缓解这一问题，但由于它们独立处理空间和时间冗余，遇到了效率的硬性上限。我们提出了VETO（面向视觉语言模型的视频高效令牌优化），这是一个无需训练的插件，通过双轴压缩消除这一瓶颈：(i) 帧内压缩器，通过受最优传输启发的匹配，合并每帧内语义相似的令牌；(ii) 帧间压缩器，识别并合并时间上冗余的帧。其关键设计洞察是层次化排序：通过先压缩空间维度，VETO大幅降低了后续全局时间匹配的成本，绕过了单轴方法的效率墙，具有优势……
tldr: VETO提出了一种无需训练的双轴压缩插件，通过先合并帧内空间相似令牌、再去除帧间时间冗余的层次化策略，突破了单轴压缩方法的效率瓶颈，实现长视频推理的高效令牌优化。
en_tdlr: VETO is a training-optional plug-in that bypasses the efficiency wall of single-axis compression by hierarchically ordering dual-axis compression—first merging semantically similar tokens within frames via optimal-transport inspired matching, then merging temporally redundant frames—enabling efficient token optimization for long-video inference in vision-language models.
